about: Pass 9 (2026-10-10): every LMArena leaderboard-dataset entry (lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset, CC BY 4.0, ledger lmarena-dataset) not yet mapped to a catalogue model. Downloaded the latest split of all 22 configs at main revision 088c607919d1d0d3385409070657f4623e414872 (= main on 2026-10-10) and the full split of the 11 imported configs. Config -> benchmark mapping used by existing rows: text_style_control -> lmarena-text, vision_style_control -> lmarena-vision, webdev -> lmarena-webdev, document_style_control -> lmarena-document, search_style_control -> lmarena-search, text_to_image -> lmarena-image, image_edit -> lmarena-image-edit, text_to_video -> lmarena-video, image_to_video -> lmarena-video-i2v, video_edit -> lmarena-video-edit, agent -> arena-agent-ips-202610; category 'overall', split 'latest', one row per catalogue model per benchmark at its highest available effort; Elo rounded to 1 decimal, agent IPS kept at full precision. Of the 1,091 overall entries in those 11 configs, 971 are already recorded under their exact label; 120 entry×config pairs (71 distinct names) were not. Earlier passes had already mapped the legacy snapshots (gpt-4-0314/0613, claude-3*, gemini-1.5-*-001, llama-2, mixtral, yi, qwen1.5, vicuna, palm-2, RWKV, …), so the remainder is mostly lower-effort/harness/resolution variants of catalogued models. Result: 3 new models (mistral-large-4, gpt-4o-search-preview, nvila-15b) and 12 rows (5 for new models, 7 for 6 catalogued models that lacked them); 6 unresolved entries in gaps; 8 owner items.

models.name: Mistral Large 4 (public preview)
models.params_note: Mistral's model page: '52B active parameters and 1.05T total parameters, and a 1.6B vision encoder'. Observed 2026-10-10.

api.price_note: Observed 2026-10-10 on Mistral's own Mistral Large 4 model page (Price, USD): original (list) price $1.36 input / $4.18 output per million tokens; cached input $0.14. The page also shows a sale price of $0.68 input / $0.07 cached / $2.09 output, which is not used here. API names mistral-large-4 and mistral-large-4-0, version 26.10, status 'Public Preview'.

models.identity_note: Mistral AI's Mistral Large 4, API model 'mistral-large-4' (alias 'mistral-large-4-0'), version 26.10, launched 6 October 2026 as a 'Public Preview' that anyone can call on Mistral's API ('You can try the preview API today on Mistral Studio'). Mistral describes it as open-weight, but the weights are not out yet: the model page's Weights link (huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B) says 'Coming soon', the repository returns HTTP 401, and the announcement says 'Weights drop end of this month'. It is therefore recorded as open_weights false with no local variant and licence 'proprietary' for now; switch both when the weights and their licence are published. Arena entry 'mistral-large-4' (organization mistral, licence 'Proprietary') first appears in the 2026-10-08 text, webdev and agent snapshots, after the public API launch. A new model, not Mistral Large 3 (mistral-large-2512).

models.name: GPT-4o Search Preview (2025-03-11)

api.price_note: Observed 2026-10-10 on OpenAI's own GPT-4o Search Preview model page (Text tokens): input $2.5, output $10 per 1M tokens. Web search calls carry an extra per-call fee, which is not included (the page refers to the pricing page). Chat Completions only.

models.context_note: OpenAI model page: '128,000 context window', '16,384 max output tokens'. Observed 2026-10-10.
models.identity_note: OpenAI API model gpt-4o-search-preview, the GPT-4o model trained to run web searches in Chat Completions. It has one snapshot, gpt-4o-search-preview-2025-03-11, which is the default the alias points to. Arena search entry 'api-gpt-4o-search' (organization openai, first published 2025-08-07). LMArena's open Search Arena battle dataset names this OpenAI system 'gpt-4o-search-preview', with '-high' and '-high-loc' variants that differ only in search_context_size or location. The Search Arena paper (arXiv 2506.05334v1, Table A1) lists 'api-gpt-4o-search-preview' as base model gpt-4o with the default config. OpenAI has no other GPT-4o search model on the API. The search_context_size behind the current leaderboard entry is not stated. Not the plain gpt-4o snapshots (gpt-4o-2024-08-06 / -11-20) and not gpt-4o-mini-search-preview.

identity_evidence.reported_label: api-gpt-4o-search-preview (Table A1: base model gpt-4o, default config)

models.name: NVILA-15B
models.identity_note: Comparison-only. NVIDIA / MIT Han Lab NVILA-15B vision-language model (arXiv 2412.04468; card: 'NVILA was trained in Nov 2024'), in repo Efficient-Large-Model/NVILA-15B @e621f62 (created 2024-12-04). The card's YAML licence is cc-by-nc-4.0, but its License section says the weights are CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0; both are non-commercial. Arena vision entry 'nvila-internal-15b-v1' (organization nvidia, first published 2024-12-22). Arena's own leaderboard table (arena-leaderboard Space @6f2eeeb, leaderboard_table_20250804.csv) displays that key as 'NVILA-15B' and links this repo. The key's 'internal ... v1' suggests NVIDIA served the model to Arena from its own endpoint. No run option is listed: the card gives no copy-paste command (it points to the NVLabs/VILA code), and NVIDIA offers no hosted API for it. Parameters are not stated beyond the name. Distinct from the catalogued VILA-U 7B.
